title: Resilient AI Service Clients
description: Build resilient AI service clients with retry policies, circuit breakers, and bulkhead isolation.

data.text: AI services can be unreliable. Implement retry policies with exponential backoff, circuit breakers to prevent cascading failures, and bulkhead isolation to limit resource usage.

data.title: Polly Resilience Pipeline
Key Takeaways
points: Retry with exponential backoff handles transient failures
Use Polly for resilience patterns in .NET
Monitor circuit state and retry metrics
data.takeaway: Resilient AI clients are essential for production systems. Implement retry, circuit breaker, and bulkhead patterns to handle AI service unreliability gracefully.
